global_issues.title: Fed hikes rates; Warsh signals path ahead
global_issues.note: Confirmed: FOMC hiked 25bp to 3.75%-4% on 2026-09-16, first hike in 3+ years, with Chair Warsh flagging persistent inflation and more hikes possible (16 of 18 officials see another hike this year). However, the 'worst week since March' claim for equities is not supported — reporting shows the S&P 500 roughly flat to down ~0.1-0.8% for the week, not a standout worst week.

global_issues.title: Saudi oil exports under pressure from regional tensions
global_issues.note: Understates and mischaracterizes the cause: the disruption stems from an Iran-affiliated attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline (Sept 10-11), not vague 'regional tensions,' with damage worse than initially thought (3 pumping stations, 5-6 week repair estimate). Direction is roughly right for Sept 18 (Brent/WTI fell ~1.5-2.3% as markets judged the supply impact softer than feared via Hormuz rerouting), but 'easing supply fears' undersells that Trump has floated re-escalating strikes on Iran, keeping real upside risk to prices.

grok_report.summary: The Fed rate-hike/Warsh narrative is accurate, but the Saudi oil story mischaracterizes the actual cause (a pipeline attack, not generic 'regional tensions') and the 'worst week since March' equity claim isn't supported by current reporting. The briefing also misses the week's dominant market-moving theme — the AI-slowdown rotation (Amodei/Altman/Musk) that hit NVDA and lifted META/MSFT — which directly contradicts the sector analysis placing META as a laggard and SMH as a leader.
